Hi Lila —

Thanks for the heads up and the report — looks like the stress runs pushed peak concurrency higher than your original profile. We can support you both ways; two pragmatic options below:

Option A — 7‑day environment top-up (no service interruption):
- We will extend your pilot environment for +7 days with identical throughput and model pinning.
- No charge if we get a short LOI (nonbinding) indicating intent to convert to a paid trial/contract within 60 days.
- Quick legal addendum only (one page) to cover timeframe and data handling.

Option B — Retro credit:
- We issue a one-time credit equal to 20% of the July overage invoice (estimate $4‑6k based on the report).
- Credit can be applied to a future Dedicated commit or to purchase more pilot tokens.

Tell me which you prefer and I’ll loop legal/finance for paperwork. If you want, we can also do Option A and lock in a short conversion discount for the first month post-pilot.

If you’re free I can jump on a 15 minute call to run through the tradeoffs.
